widget_info_docs.get_hierarchy:
X.get_hierarchy(widget_path) -> Array[WidgetInfo]
Get widget hierarchy for a Widget Blueprint.

Args:
    widget_path (str): Full path to the Widget Blueprint

Returns:
    Array[WidgetInfo]: Array of widget information in hierarchy order
widget_info_docs.get_property:
X.get_property(widget_path, component_name, property_name) -> str
Get a specific property value from a widget component.
Maps to action="get_property"

Args:
    widget_path (str): Full path to the Widget Blueprint
    component_name (str): Name of the component
    property_name (str): Name of the property to get

Returns:
    str: Property value as string (empty if not found)
